method: Read-only extraction of original rustfmt Diff in blocks, normalize only runner path separators. Match complete preimages to git show f070 and postimages/addition runs to git show dde; two final-file hunks include one virtual blank EOF context line printed by rustfmt, explicitly recorded. No formatter, build or test execution.
conclusion: All 72 rustfmt hunks in each retained log are covered by dde across 11 Rust paths; the two logs contain the identical normalized hunk sequence. This does not claim a rerun or successful remote CI gate.
